years: production years not published (Eminent, Netherlands; dealer listing 2026)
notes: The same dealer's E28 page reprints this E26 disposition, so the E28 was not made into a separate template.
Eminent organs have three selectable intonations (styles); the stop names are the English names printed in the dealer's specification.
Each division also has a 'Library stop' (a user-assignable voice from the Eminent Voice Library). It is not included here; add it in the editor if you use it.
ASSUMED MIDI channels: Great 1, Swell 2, Pedal 3. Eminent does not publish them: check on the MIDI monitor (play each manual and the pedals) and correct the channels before recording.

Per-stop MIDI messages are not published (Hauptwerk's console presets describe Eminent stop changes as bitfield-style controller or Program Change schemes that Cecilia cannot map to single stops), so every stop is unbound: use Learn every stop, and expect that some stops may not be learnable.
No expression or master-volume controller is documented, so none is set.
Stop list: https://idmusikk.no/?p=1257260 (ID Musikk, Norwegian Eminent dealer, church organ product page 'Eminent E26': 31 speaking stops, 30-note pedal)

MIDI scheme: No Eminent MIDI implementation is published (the dealer specification lists only MIDI In-Out-Thru; eminent.nl is offline and no owner's manual with a MIDI chapter was found). Division channels are an assumption, not documented.
